game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart, the glowing heart of the ruins: the rune scholar must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Index Archery: Hit targets by choosing the right list index, including negative ones.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart: the glowing heart of the ruins
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Declare float: declare resource as float, apply resource + 2.5, and print each result with %.1f. Dataset 2 starts with [-3, 0, 9, 12]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Index Archery' (Week 7 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Eldritch Heart'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the crypt seal from rune wisps in Eldritch Heart: keep the arrows meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: arrows drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
hint: Declare before use. float resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %.1f.
